name: Code Rain
description: The first clip darkens into a grid of flickering code characters tinted by its colors, then glowing streams of characters fall down the columns at their own speeds, each with a bright head and a fading tail, leaving the second clip behind. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cell_size
params.description: Height of a character, in frame heights

params.name: trail
params.description: Average length of the streams' fading tails, in frame heights

params.name: tint
params.description: How much the characters of the first clip take its colors, instead of the glow color

params.name: glow
params.description: Color of the falling streams and their glow
